headline: First real cell-eval run — mean-shift floor vs VCC 2025 validation (H1 hESC, 50 targets)

inputs.source_note: Arc Institute public bucket; 98,927 cells × 18,080 genes, 50 perturbations + non-targeting

artifact_retention: prediction + normalized h5ads live under gitignored data/raw (369MB+); committed artifacts are metrics/audit/facts/enrichment only (docs/release-infrastructure.md)
scoring_subsample: score matrix subsampled (seed 0): 200 cells/perturbation, 3000 controls (~13k cells) — full-depth 51-group DE ran ~12h ETA on this hardware; k003 will score full depth. Scripts: data/raw/vcc2025/subsample_k002.py, score_k002_sub.sh
hypotheses_preregistered: Zero-shift floor: DESigGenesRecall lands at or near zero — a constant prediction has no DE genes to recall
Mean absolute error will beat replicate-naive intuition but pearson_delta will sit far below the computed ceiling
notes: First run scored by the REAL cell-eval 0.8.2 (k001 was mock/probe). Mean-shift baseline predicts the lognorm control mean for every target, 100 cells per group.
